# ♿ Accessibility Review

- Feature / PR:
- Commit:
- Reviewer:

- Browser and version:
- Assistive technology and version:
- Viewport / zoom:

## Keyboard operation

- [ ] All controls are reachable in logical Tab order.
- [ ] Focus is visible and not obscured.
- [ ] Enter submits the form once.
- [ ] Clear and minimize/expand controls work by keyboard.
- [ ] No keyboard trap is present.
- [ ] Focus remains understandable after clearing or hiding content.

## Screen reader and semantics

- [ ] Chat region has a meaningful accessible name.
- [ ] Message log announces additions politely.
- [ ] User and bot messages are distinguishable from context.
- [ ] Buttons expose accessible names and expanded state.
- [ ] Decorative graphics do not add redundant announcements.
- [ ] Hidden/minimized content is not exposed incorrectly.

## Visual and motion checks

- [ ] Text and controls have sufficient measured contrast.
- [ ] 200% zoom remains usable.
- [ ] Narrow viewport reflows without horizontal scrolling.
- [ ] Text spacing and long messages remain readable.
- [ ] Reduced-motion preference is respected.
- [ ] Color is not the only indicator of state.

## Findings

| Issue | WCAG reference, if applicable | Severity | Evidence | Owner |
|---|---|---|---|---|

## Limits and decision

List untested browser/assistive technology combinations. State approved / needs changes / not assessed. Do not claim WCAG conformance from a short checklist alone.
